notes: Read the line-numbered source before editing; every one of the 454 source lines was considered. Header doc comment (L1-27) ported and adapted for native (the discriminated-union invariant, all_sticky mutual-exclusion + previous-selection memory, and unknown-id preservation are kept verbatim; the web '<button role=checkbox>' / custom-popover / i18next implementation notes are rewritten to describe the native Modal + Pressable equivalents). Imports (L29-42): react hooks kept (useCallback/useEffect/useId/useMemo/useRef/useState), the DOM 'type KeyboardEvent as ReactKeyboardEvent' import dropped (handleTriggerKey has no native analog); react-i18next useTranslation (L38) replaced by a native-safe useNativeTranslationFallback returning t(key, fallback?, params?) that interpolates i18next-style {{name}}/{{count}}/{{total}}/{{id}} placeholders (preserves every translation key + i18n intent); lucide-react ChevronDown (L39) rendered as a decorative AppText chevron glyph that rotates 180deg when open; '@/types/vehicle' Vehicle (L40) imported from the native '../../api/types'; '@/components/ui' Badge (L41) reproduced locally as a minimal native-safe Badge (neutral+warning, sm); cn (L42) dropped in favour of StyleSheet + tokens.

VehicleSelection discriminated union (L44-46) preserved verbatim. VehicleMultiSelectProps (L48-61) preserved: value, onChange, vehicles, errorKey?, disabled?, id?, className? kept with JSDoc; className keeps its slot for source compatibility but is ignored on native (destructured as _className); the web-only ref forwarding is not part of the prop shape. SENTINEL_ID const (L63) preserved verbatim ('all_sticky_sentinel') and used as the All-option testID suffix exactly like the web data-testid.

Pure helpers ported verbatim: lastFourVin (L65-68) — null when vin missing/<4 chars else last 4; vehicleLabel (L70-76) — display_name||model||'Vehicle #id' base, with the same '— model' and '(VIN ...last4)' assembly branches; dedupSort (L78-89) — id>0 + Set-dedupe preserving first occurrence then numeric ascending sort. Logic and comments are identical (only Prettier brace/style formatting differs).

Component signature + ids (L91-104): useTranslation() -> useNativeTranslationFallback(); useId()/triggerId = id ?? generatedId/popoverId/errorId preserved (triggerId -> Pressable nativeID, popoverId/errorId -> popover/error nativeIDs for label association parity). open useState(false) (L105) preserved. The web containerRef (HTMLDivElement, L106) is dropped because its sole purpose was mousedown click-outside hit-testing (now the Modal backdrop); triggerRef (L107, HTMLButtonElement) becomes a View ref used to measureInWindow() and anchor the popover (web 'absolute mt-1 w-full'); an anchor useState was added to hold that measurement.

State derivations preserved verbatim: previousSpecificRef (L109-111) initialised from a specific value's ids, and its sync effect (L112-116, [value] deps) updating the ref only while kind==='specific' — this is what makes Toggle-All-OFF restore the prior subset (D13). knownIds memo (L118), selectedIds (L119), and unknownIds memo (L120-123) ported verbatim (the inner param renamed id->vid only to avoid shadowing the id prop; behaviour identical). isFleetEmpty (L125) preserved.

triggerSummary memo (L127-165) ported verbatim through native t(): all_sticky -> vehiclesSummaryAll 'All vehicles'; count===0 -> vehiclesSummaryNone 'No vehicles selected'; count===1 -> vehiclesSummaryOne '{{name}}' with the same veh lookup (display_name||model||'Vehicle #id'); total>0 && count<total -> vehiclesSummaryPartial '{{count}} of {{total}} vehicles'; else vehiclesSummaryCount '{{count}} vehicles'. Same deps [value, selectedIds, vehicles, t].

Outside-click + Escape effect (L167-187, window mousedown/keydown): React Native has no window/DOM, so this is replaced by the <Modal> primitive — a full-screen backdrop Pressable (onPress=close) is the click-outside analog and Modal onRequestClose=close is the Android-back analog of Escape; triggerRef.current?.focus() restoration is a no-op on native (documented). close useCallback added (parity with the ListExportMenu port). handleToggleAll (L189-196) and handleToggleVehicle (L198-208) ported verbatim incl. the D13 restore comment and dedupSort add path. handleTriggerKey (L210-218, ArrowDown/Enter/Space to open) has no native analog and is intentionally omitted — the Pressable onPress opens the popover (documented). errorText/hasError (L220-221) preserved; a disabledTrigger = disabled||isFleetEmpty was extracted to mirror the web button's disabled attr (L229).

Render: root div (L224) -> View (position relative; cn className dropped). Trigger button (L225-257): the web <button id type aria-haspopup=listbox aria-expanded aria-controls aria-describedby disabled onClick onKeyDown> becomes a Pressable ref=triggerRef nativeID=triggerId accessibilityRole='button' accessibilityState={{disabled, expanded: open}} accessibilityLabel=triggerSummary disabled=disabledTrigger onPress=toggle testID='vehicle-multiselect-trigger'. The inner truncating span + Badge variant='neutral' size='sm' (L245-249) becomes the local Badge in a flexShrink row. ChevronDown (L250-256) with 'rotate-180' on open becomes a decorative AppText '\u25BE' with a transform rotate(180deg) style when open (accessibilityElementsHidden mirrors aria-hidden). hasError/default/disabled border + focus-visible ring classes map to triggerError/triggerDefault/triggerDisabled/triggerPressed StyleSheet styles.

Empty-fleet help (L259-266): the

becomes an AppText (testID vehicle-multiselect-empty-help) with vehiclesEmptyFleetHelp 'Add a vehicle in Settings -> Vehicles to use this rule.'. Inline error (L268-272): the

becomes an AppText nativeID=errorId accessibilityLiveRegion='assertive' (role=alert analog) tone-danger testID=vehicle-multiselect-error. The popover gate {open && !isFleetEmpty} (L274) is reproduced as Modal visible={open && !isFleetEmpty}.

Popover (L274-412): the absolutely-positioned <div id role=listbox aria-multiselectable aria-labelledby max-h-72 overflow-auto shadow-lg> is rendered inside a transparent <Modal> (backdrop Pressable for outside-tap + onRequestClose). RN has no 'listbox' role, so the menu View carries accessibilityLabel + accessibilityViewIsModal + nativeID=popoverId and is positioned via the measured anchor (web mt-1 w-full = full trigger width, just below; a top fallback style is used when measurement is unavailable, e.g. headless tests). A ScrollView (maxHeight 280, keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled') reproduces overflow-auto + max-h-72. The All-vehicles option (L282-317): <button role=checkbox aria-checked onClick=handleToggleAll data-testid> -> Pressable accessibilityRole='checkbox' accessibilityState={{checked: value.kind==='all_sticky'}} onPress=handleToggleAll testID=`vehicle-multiselect-option-${SENTINEL_ID}`; the 4x4 bordered checkbox + inline SVG check (L295-309) becomes a View checkbox (accent fill when checked) containing a '\u2713' AppText; the font-medium label (L310-315) -> optionLabelStrong with vehiclesAllOption 'All vehicles (current + future)'. Divider (L319) -> a 1px View.

Per-vehicle options (L321-363): vehicles.map with checked = specific && vehicle_ids.includes(v.id) preserved; each <button role=checkbox aria-checked onClick=handleToggleVehicle(v.id) data-testid=`...option-${v.id}`> becomes a Pressable with the same accessibilityRole/state, onPress, and testID, a checkbox indicator, and a truncating optionLabel = vehicleLabel(v). Unknown ids block (L365-410): gated on unknownIds.length>0, a divider then unknownIds.map renders <button role=checkbox aria-checked=true onClick=handleToggleVehicle(id) data-testid=`...option-unknown-${id}`> -> Pressable (always-checked indicator), a muted optionLabelMuted = vehiclesUnknownLabel 'Vehicle #{{id}}', and the local Badge variant='warning' vehiclesUnknownBadge 'Unknown'. Every web data-testid is preserved 1:1 as a native testID.

Exported pure helpers ported verbatim: hydrateVehicleSelection (L417-438) — honours a boolean all_vehicles (true -> all_sticky; false -> specific dedupSort(vehicle_ids ?? [])) and falls back to the legacy vehicle_id (null -> all_sticky else specific [vehicle_id]) (Decisions D12); buildVehiclePayload (L440-454) — all_sticky -> {all_vehicles:true, vehicle_ids:[]}; specific -> {all_vehicles:false, vehicle_ids: dedupSort(...)} (Decisions D11/D14). JSDoc preserved. Trailing newline (L455) covered.

No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported — only React, react-native primitives (Modal/Pressable/ScrollView/StyleSheet/View), the existing native AppText, theme tokens (colors/spacing), and the native Vehicle type. All Tailwind/CSS-var classes are reproduced with StyleSheet + tokens (surface/surfaceGlass/border/borderAccent/danger/accent/warningSurface/warningBorder/textPrimary/textSecondary/textMuted, rounded-md, max-h-72, shadow-lg). Behaviour verified by __tests__/VehicleMultiSelect.test.tsx (11 tests: open/list options, toggle-all to all_sticky, toggle-all-off restore D13, add/remove vehicle dedupSort, unknown-id row + removal, summary text for all/none/partial/one, empty-fleet disabled + help, assertive error, hydrateVehicleSelection all_vehicles + legacy fallback, buildVehiclePayload both flags). Gates: npm run typecheck PASS, npm run lint -- --quiet PASS, npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles PASS.
